result.title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
result.summary: Large pretrained language models provide capable policies for interactive tasks, but how much model capacity is necessary for a specialized language agent? We introduce ZeroHero, a framework for training small language agents (SLAs) from scratch. In each environment, a large language model acts as the expert, and we collect its successful trajectories. We pretrain each SLA, which has fewer than 50 million parameters, to predict the expert's responses given the interaction history. We then post-train the agent on its own interactions using proximal policy optimization (PPO). During post-training, reasoning alignment supplements environment rewards with expert supervision on the language the agent generates alongside its actions. We evaluate the agents in three multistep environments where acting requires both understanding and generating language. In Crafter, agents interpret textual observations and generate reasoning before acting. In WebShop, they translate shopping instructions into search queries. In Alfworld-Dialogue, they ask clarifying questions and use the answers to guide household actions. The agents approach expert performance on WebShop and surpass their respective demonstration experts on Crafter training rollouts and held-out Alfworld-Dialogue tasks. An interactive demo is available at https://zoyav.github.io/-ZoyaV-zerohero-demo.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ZeroHero，从零训练参数少于 5000 万的小型语言智能体：先用大模型成功轨迹做预训练，再用 PPO 在自身交互上后训练，并以专家监督对齐动作旁的语言推理，在 Crafter、WebShop、Alfworld-Dialogue 中评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自采样轨迹 + 推理对齐的专家监督」训练监督线索，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹级训练、中间推理步骤的贡献分配与监督信号设计，但对象为纯文本交互智能体，不含视觉状态，迁移需较多推断。
